## 1. The Core Idea

A hash map (also called hash table, dictionary, associative array) stores key-value pairs and provides fast lookup. The naive alternatives:
- Unsorted array: O(n) lookup
- Sorted array: O(log n) lookup, O(n) insertion
- Balanced BST: O(log n) for everything

Hash maps aim for O(1) average-case by using a hash function to compute where to store each entry directly.
